== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
* [[Chazek Plague Herder]] ([[Unwaking Waters (explorable area)]])

==Hero Usage==
* Heroes seem to use this skill more often on locked targets.

== Notes ==
* Can permanently keep a group of foes on the ground in PvE if using at least 19 in [[Fast Casting]] (reachable via [[Heroic Refrain]]) under [[Quickening Zephyr]], assuming the user manages to succesfully interrupt the first skill the mob uses every time they recover from the knockdown.
* The knockdown will not occur if the interruption is prevented.

==Trivia==
*This is one of the few skills with a concise description longer than its normal one.
*This skill causes one of the longest [[knock down]]s of any player-usable skills.
*In PvE, this skill synergizes with "[[Of the (Profession)|of the Mesmer]]" weapon upgrades to avoid the "50% failure chance with Fast Casting 4 or less."
